# idsec_sia_k8s_list_clusters (Data Source)

The SIA K8s list clusters data source, lists the K8s clusters available for the current user.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `output_file` (String) Save the clusters list as a JSON file to this path.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) List of K8s clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_address` (String) Address of the K8s cluster.
- `cluster_username` (String) Username used to connect to the K8s cluster.
- `is_reason_required` (Boolean) Whether a reason is required in order to access this cluster.
- `reason` (String) Reason for accessing the cluster, required when generating cluster access and IsReasonRequired is true.
